summary: Configured node1’s systemd-resolved as a persistent local caching DNS resolver. Applications use 127.0.0.53, external DNS remains available through configured and DHCP-provided upstreams, and the configuration survived a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Added persistent Cache=yes, DNSCacheSize=4096, and DNSStubListener=yes settings.
Verified successful external lookups and a cache hit.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed and DNS fully recovered.

evidence.summary: Shows the enabled/active service, persistent configuration, 127.0.0.53 UDP/TCP listener, application resolver path, and observed cache hit.
External archlinux.org lookups succeed, with global and DHCP-provided upstream DNS servers present before and after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID fe6e58b2-7e4d-4e8a-b1d7-3a15564059bb; reboot was acknowledged; post-reboot boot ID changed to 611cec02-4b59-4696-b0b8-172d79a6e549; service, configuration, listener, external resolution, and caching recovered.
